equivalence.scope: Independent ROM decoding: all HUD/boundary writes and code shapes/cycle estimates; preserved graphic tables, all round maps/terrain; boot destinations/payload/order/deadlines. Emulator behavior and timing are verified separately.

hud_native.scope: All64x64 known transitions and64 cold starts, all physical pattern sets. Previous inactive slots seeded unknown. Exact current active glyph bytes and full128KiB VRAM guards; inactive HUD bytes may retain old or receive current source during gap merging. Current phase mapping/IFF preserved. IRQs enabled/exercised across probe, not inside every call. Wrapper timing includes IRQs; no gameplay FPS claim.

profile_comparison.workload: Full session, keyboard coin/start and F5 to native round5 (RND4), layout1, three native enemies; frames5..360, fixed directional input
profile_comparison.scope: Player/camera coordinates, all three native enemy records, input/tick state and VDP R9/R18 exposed by the matched profiler. Each ROM also has an uninstrumented control. Per-frame observation jitter is bounded; equal total duration. Short deterministic three-enemy active-play sample; no complete-course or physical-hardware acceptance.

limitations: Automated emulation and a short matched three-moving-enemy active-play workload; not physical hardware or complete human-course acceptance.
VDP VR span is distinct from usable VBlank budget; 5000 cycles remains a planning assumption.
Packing holes describe the free ranges after transfer-code placement, before the boot fragments consume them.
Allocation categories own every bank once; shared transfer family bank totals overlap and must not be added.
